description: Study Groups — NestJS backend module (entities, service, controller, DTOs, module registration) plus Flutter Web UI (study_groups_screen.dart with Discover/My Groups tabs, FAB to create group, route /study-groups, sidebar entry, API constants). Independent of FEAT-001.
steps: 1. Create entity file `backend/src/modules/study-groups/entities/study-group.entity.ts`. Use @Entity('study_groups'). Fields: @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid') id; @Column({length:200}) name; @Column({type:'text',nullable:true}) description; @Column({name:'department_id',nullable:true}) departmentId: string; @Column({name:'created_by'}) createdBy: string; @Column({name:'max_members',default:50}) maxMembers: number; @Column({name:'is_active',default:true}) isActive: boolean; @CreateDateColumn({name:'created_at'}) createdAt: Date. Import Entity, PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Column, CreateDateColumn from typeorm.

2. Create entity file `backend/src/modules/study-groups/entities/study-group-member.entity.ts`. Use @Entity('study_group_members') @Unique(['groupId','userId']). Fields: @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid') id; @Column({name:'group_id'}) groupId: string; @Column({name:'user_id'}) @Index() userId: string; @CreateDateColumn({name:'joined_at'}) joinedAt: Date. Import Entity, PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Column, CreateDateColumn, Unique, Index from typeorm.

3. Create DTO files in `backend/src/modules/study-groups/dto/`. File `create-study-group.dto.ts`: class CreateStudyGroupDto with @IsString() @MaxLength(200) name; @IsOptional() @IsString() description?; @IsOptional() @IsInt() @Min(2) @Max(200) maxMembers?. Use class-validator decorators. File `query-study-groups.dto.ts`: class QueryStudyGroupsDto with @IsOptional() @IsUUID() departmentId?.

4. Create `backend/src/modules/study-groups/study-groups.service.ts` with @Injectable() StudyGroupsService. Inject @InjectRepository(StudyGroup) repo and @InjectRepository(StudyGroupMember) memberRepo. Implement: findByDepartment(departmentId: string) — finds active groups with member count using QueryBuilder; createGroup(userId: string, dto: CreateStudyGroupDto, departmentId?: string); joinGroup(userId: string, groupId: string) — throws ConflictException if already member, NotFoundException if group not found, ForbiddenException if at capacity; leaveGroup(userId: string, groupId: string); findUserGroups(userId: string). All DB access via TypeORM repositories, no raw SQL.

5. Create `backend/src/modules/study-groups/study-groups.controller.ts`. @ApiTags('Study Groups') @ApiBearerAuth() @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) @Controller('study-groups'). Endpoints: GET / with @Query() query: QueryStudyGroupsDto (calls service.findByDepartment); POST / @Body() dto: CreateStudyGroupDto (calls service.createGroup with @CurrentUser() user); POST /:id/join (calls service.joinGroup); DELETE /:id/leave (calls service.leaveGroup); GET /my (calls service.findUserGroups). Use @CurrentUser() decorator following the pattern in community.controller.ts.

6. Create `backend/src/modules/study-groups/study-groups.module.ts`. @Module({ imports: [TypeOrmModule.forFeature([StudyGroup, StudyGroupMember])], providers: [StudyGroupsService], controllers: [StudyGroupsController] }). Export StudyGroupsService.

7. Register StudyGroupsModule in `backend/src/app.module.ts`: add import { StudyGroupsModule } from './modules/study-groups/study-groups.module' and add StudyGroupsModule to the imports array (at the end of the feature modules list). TypeORM entity glob auto-discovers the new entities so no separate entity registration is needed.
8. Append the three CREATE TABLE statements and five CREATE INDEX statements to `database/schema.sql` as specified in the task (study_groups table, study_group_members table, and all five indexes).

9. Add study groups API constants to `web_app/lib/core/constants/api_constants.dart`: static const String studyGroups = '/study-groups'; static const String studyGroupsMy = '/study-groups/my'; static String joinStudyGroup(String id) => '/study-groups/$id/join'; static String leaveStudyGroup(String id) => '/study-groups/$id/leave'.

10. Create `web_app/lib/presentation/screens/study_groups/study_groups_screen.dart` as a ConsumerStatefulWidget with a DefaultTabController (length: 2). Two providers: discoverGroupsProvider (FutureProvider.autoDispose.family<List<Map<String,dynamic>>, String> that calls GET /study-groups?departmentId=X using ref.read(apiClientProvider)) and myGroupsProvider (FutureProvider.autoDispose that calls GET /study-groups/my). Tabs: 'Discover' shows discoverGroupsProvider for user's departmentId; 'My Groups' shows myGroupsProvider. Each group card (Card widget) shows: group name (bold), description (2-line overflow), member count chip, and a Join/Leave ElevatedButton. Join calls POST /study-groups/:id/join; Leave calls DELETE /study-groups/:id/leave; both invalidate both providers on success and show a SnackBar. FAB (FloatingActionButton with icon Icons.add) opens an AlertDialog with TextFormFields for name (required, max 200) and description (optional); on submit calls POST /study-groups and invalidates providers. Use AppColors throughout, Nunito font, no hardcoded hex. Import apiClientProvider from core/network/api_client.dart and currentUserProvider from core/providers/auth_provider.dart.

11. Add route /study-groups to `web_app/lib/app/router/app_router.dart`: import StudyGroupsScreen, add GoRoute(path: '/study-groups', name: 'study-groups', builder: (_, __) => const StudyGroupsScreen()) inside the ShellRoute routes list.

12. Add 'Study Groups' nav item to `web_app/lib/app/shell/app_shell.dart` _navItems list, between Library and Profile: (label: 'Study Groups', route: '/study-groups', icon: Icons.groups_outlined). Add import for icons if needed (Icons.groups_outlined is in material).
13. Verify: npm run lint in backend (exit 0); flutter analyze in web_app (no issues).
